Name: Hide Hours Played
Author: captmaestra
Description:
[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Have you ever loaded your Stardew Valley save and thought, “Wait... I've played HOW many hours?”
Well, suffer no more! This simple mod hides your total playtime from the load-game screen, so you can keep pretending you didn't waste over 100 hours on your latest farm.
No judgment. We all know that “just one more day” was a lie.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
The mod only hides the displayed playtime. [b]It does not change, reset, or delete your actual playtime.[/b] Your hours are still there—they're just safely out of sight, where they can't judge you.
The mod includes a simple configuration option through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b], allowing you to turn the playtime display on or off whenever you want.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]That's it. One small quality-of-life improvement for anyone who would rather not be confronted with the consequences of their farming addiction every time they load a game. Because sometimes, ignorance really is bliss.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Unzip the downloaded mod and place the mod folder in your Stardew Valley mods folder. .[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) is recommended but optional.[/b]
If you don't have or don't want to use GMCM, simply launch your game and play a save once so the mod can create its config.json file. You can then open config.json in Notepad and change the setting from "true" to "false" or "false" to "true"  depending on whether you want your playtime displayed or hidden. 

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[b]Thank you, ConcernedApe, for creating a truly engrossing game where “just one more day” can somehow turn into many more hours of farming, fishing, mining, decorating, befriending villagers and battling monsters.[/b]
[b]And thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and the SMAPI team for making little quality-of-life mods like this possible.[/b]

[b][size=4]Now go forth and farm guilt free![/size][/b]
